## Weather Tool
**Purpose:** fetch current conditions from Open-Meteo and normalize safety-relevant fields.
**Input:** POST /webhook/pulse/weather with location.lat/lng.
**Output:** temperature, precipitation, rain, wind, weatherCode and generatedAt.
**Credentials:** none.
**Dependencies:** Open-Meteo public API.
**Failure path:** safe WEATHER_UNAVAILABLE response; route planning can continue.

parameters.jsCode: const request=$('Validate Weather Location').first().json;if(!request.valid)return[{json:{ok:false,error:{code:'INVALID_LOCATION',message:'Ubicación inválida.'}}}];const current=$json.current;if(!current)return[{json:{ok:false,error:{code:'WEATHER_UNAVAILABLE',message:'El clima no está disponible temporalmente.'},provider:'open-meteo',generatedAt:new Date().toISOString()}}];return[{json:{ok:true,provider:'open-meteo',temperature:current.temperature_2m??null,precipitation:current.precipitation??null,rain:current.rain??null,wind:current.wind_speed_10m??null,weatherCode:current.weather_code??null,visibility:Array.isArray($json.hourly?.visibility)?$json.hourly.visibility[0]:null,warning:Number(current.precipitation??0)>4?'Precaución: lluvia intensa modelada en esta zona.':null,sourceUpdatedAt:current.time??null,generatedAt:new Date().toISOString()}}];
